title: Marguerite and the Hollow
author: Wendell Iversen
blurb: Lior Dunmore, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
